# Senseible

> Senseible turns ordinary business documents — invoices, energy bills, fuel slips — into verified carbon outcomes, compliance evidence, and monetisable climate data in under 47 seconds. Built for MSMEs across India and emerging Asia.

Senseible is an AI-powered carbon Measurement, Reporting and Verification (MRV) infrastructure layer. It is operated as a public, no-login interface (Senseible) that feeds a logged-in B2B reporting workspace (Biocog). The platform deterministically classifies HSN codes against the GHG Protocol, applies IEA 2023 grid factors localised for 10 countries (India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines, Pakistan, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Sri Lanka), and produces audit-grade Scope 1, 2 and 3 emission records suitable for CBAM, BRSR, GRI, TCFD, ISO 14064, ISO 14067 and GHG Protocol disclosure.

The audience is MSME owners, sustainability leads, exporters facing the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, lenders running green-loan books, carbon credit buyers, and ERP/ESG software vendors that need a verification primitive. Senseible is operated by Biocog Technologies (Gurugram, India) and contactable at impact@senseible.earth.

## Core product

- [Senseible homepage](/): single-input surface to upload, capture, or speak a document and receive a verified emission estimate.
- [Verify](/verify): deterministic verification flow with confidence bands, SHA-256 evidence hashes, and dispute simulation.
- [Monetize](/monetize): converts verified evidence into carbon credit and green finance signals.
- [Calculators hub](/calculators): five free public calculators (PCF, supplier risk, energy transition, logistics, carbon pricing).
- [CBAM cost calculator](/cbam-calculator): EU CBAM exposure estimator using CN customs codes and quarterly default values.
- [Net-Zero engine](/net-zero): five-step roadmap turning a baseline into tracked, sector-specific reduction tasks.
- [Industries](/industries): sector landing pages for 15 MSME industries.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): MSME-issued credit listings with provenance badges.
- [Partner portal](/partners): integrations for carbon buyers, banks, ERP and climate-finance partners.
- [Trust & Technical Validation](/trust): consolidated public reference for partners, auditors, lenders and credit buyers — trust layers, MRV pipeline, framework coverage, Scope 3 traceability, confidence scoring, greenwashing prevention, governance.
